scope: Candidate registry for S5-21. It separates local interpreter profiles from composed CPL0 and exact machine CPL3 evidence. No guest-userland support is inferred from local fixture results. The registry is incomplete; unmatched rows remain unclassified.

classification_policy.supported_requires: an exact accepted form and its mode/CPL, prefix, width, operand, addressing, state, and feature gates to match the observed instruction row; the evidence_scope is retained and never merged across scopes
classification_policy.missing_requires: an explicit plan or contract statement that the exact observed form is unsupported or remains open; absence from this candidate registry is not missing evidence

profiles.execution_mode: Long64 interpreter fixture; no machine CPL is asserted
profiles.common_gates: bounded synchronous GuestMemory; canonical48 memory accesses; documented 66/67/REX normalization; FS/GS data overrides, LOCK, and REP are excluded except where a separate exact profile says otherwise

families.operands: immediate/register and register/r/m MOV; widths 8/16/32/64; 16 GPR; high-byte aliases only without effective REX
families.outcome: successful forms and bounded faults

families.operands: moffs, immediate MOV, MOVSX/MOVSXD/MOVZX, LEA, register XCHG and NOP; exact widths and address forms are bounded by CPU contract
families.outcome: successful forms; LEA register-source #UD is fault-only

families.operands: ADD/ADC/SBB/SUB/CMP and INC/DEC/NEG; register/rm, accumulator/immediate and group/immediate forms; imm8/imm32 sign extension as specified
families.outcome: successful forms and bounded faults

families.operands: AND/OR/XOR, TEST, NOT; register/rm, accumulator/immediate, group/immediate; TEST has no destination write
families.outcome: successful forms and bounded faults

families.operands: single shifts/rotates and SHLD/SHRD; register/memory; immediate, 1, or CL count
families.outcome: successful forms; undefined count/flag outputs excluded from exact comparison

families.operands: MUL/IMUL/DIV/IDIV r/m and bounded IMUL register/immediate forms
families.outcome: successful forms physically verified; #DE behavior local-only

profiles.outcome: VERW computes ZF; no segment load
